text:
alex: Quick heads-up: I opened a PR that adds a compact ingest example, plus Go/JS meter header snippets and an exportable demo CSV for quota dashboards. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1310

priya: Nice. Can you keep the CSV minimal (3 tenants, 48 rows) so reviewers can import into Grafana Loki or a local DB quickly?

alex: Yep keeping it tiny. I'll include a one-command import in the README: 

```bash
# import demo CSV into local sqlite for panel tests
sqlite3 demo.db '.mode csv' '.import demo_usage.csv usage'
```

ken: Heads-up on wording: our glossary calls the field "units" whereas billing calls it "billing_unit". Inconsistency will confuse users. Suggest we standardize docs to "billing_unit" and keep an alias note for older guides.

nina: Also add a note about timezone handling in the CSV -> Grafana pipeline. People import UTC rows and their dashboard looks empty due to local timezone offsets. Simple note: timestamps should be ISO8601 UTC.

alex: Good call. I'll add an explicit example row: 

`2026-03-01T00:00:00Z,tenant_demo,generation,512`

priya: Can we include a short Go snippet showing the header shape? A lot of customers use the Go SDK and we've seen malformed meter headers. Something like: 

```go
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+token)
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Meter", "tenant=tenant_demo;billing_unit=tokens;amount=512")
```

ken: Add a JS fetch example too — people copy curl but want fetch for frontend demos (with caution about exposing keys).

alex: Will do: 

```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.inference/v1/usage', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`,
    'X-Redwood-Meter': 'tenant=tenant_demo;billing_unit=tokens;amount=512',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({timestamp: '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z', route: '/v1/generate', tokens: 512})
})
```

nina: Add a short migration paragraph: older SDKs v1/v2 used `X-Redwood-Quota` header. Note the mapping and include a tiny conversion script. That reduced confusion in last migration.

alex: I'll add a conversion snippet and link to the migration guide. Also adding PromQL for the dashboard aggregate: 

```promql
sum by (tenant) (increase(redwood_meter_tokens_total[1h]))
```

priya: Can you call out how burst credits appear (they look like negative usage adjustments sometimes) and include the alert FAQ: when to blame tenant misconfiguration vs delayed ingestion?

alex: Yep — short FAQ entry: delayed ingestion -> spikes in historical panels; burst credits -> separate metric `redwood_burst_credit_balance` shown on the right axis.

docs-bot: linkcheck started for PR #1310

ken: I skimmed the preview and one nit: panel title "Usage by Tenant" should be renamed "Billing units by tenant (1h)" to match the PromQL aggregation window.

alex: Good: updating panel title and PR description. Also going to include a tiny smoke test command to verify Prometheus metrics are present: 

```bash
curl -s 'http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(redwood_rate_limiter_credits_total[5m]))' | jq .
```

priya: Looks solid. Approving once the timezone note + migration blurb are in.

docs-bot: preview available at https://deploy-preview-1310--docs.redwood.ai/ (checks: lint, linkcheck, accessibility)

alex: Thanks — merging after docs-bot checks green. Will follow up with localized snippets in a separate PR.

docs-bot: PR #1310 merged by alex. Release note: "metering: compact ingest examples, SDK header snippets, demo CSV + dashboard import"
